description: Every skeleton W of at most 13 letters (1 = s1, -2 = s2^-1, 3 = s3; starts and ends with s1 or s3) whose family (W s2^-d)^3 has a parent root with real part < -1, out of 1,038,334 searched. limit_root = (Re, |Im|) of the leftmost such root; rouche_d0 = twist from which every member has a root within 0.08 of it.
